_meta._note: Wave 1C — Multi-agent collaboration benchmarks. Frontier-disclosed scores only (strict-attribution): MultiAgentBench/MARBLE Table 1 (ACL 2025) per-scenario Task Score (TS%) for the 5 explicitly-named LLM backbones, AgentBench Overall (OA, ICLR 2024) for API-based frontier models, and MetaGPT SoftwareDev Executability (ICLR 2024) for the GPT-4 scaffolded multi-agent framework. Anonymized 'best model' rows or extrapolated values were excluded. Multi-agent collaboration research is academic-heavy in 2024-2025, so per-model disclosures are sparse vs. single-agent benchmarks; sticking to paper-published Tables only. AGORA-Bench/VillagerBench/PillagerBench/MAgIC paper tables checked but did not yield per-frontier-model scores in extractable form (paper text only references aggregate gaps); deferred. AutoGen/AutoGen Studio has no published model-level leaderboard — it's a framework, not an eval target. GPT-3.5-turbo entries from MultiAgentBench/AgentBench excluded per repo policy on 2년+된 모델.

benchmarks.name: MultiAgentBench Research (Task Score)
benchmarks.description: Research scenario Task Score (TS%) from MultiAgentBench/MARBLE (ACL 2025, arxiv 2503.01935). Multi-agent collaborative research task with milestone-based KPI; agents coordinate via star/chain/tree/graph topologies. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: MultiAgentBench Coding (Task Score)
benchmarks.description: Coding scenario Task Score (TS%) from MultiAgentBench/MARBLE (ACL 2025). Multi-agent collaborative software task with role-specialized agents and milestone-graded outcomes. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: MultiAgentBench Bargaining (Task Score)
benchmarks.description: Bargaining scenario Task Score (TS%) from MultiAgentBench/MARBLE (ACL 2025). Competitive multi-agent negotiation; measures task achievement under adversarial peer agents. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: MultiAgentBench Minecraft (Task Score)
benchmarks.description: Minecraft cooperative-build scenario Task Score (TS%) from MultiAgentBench/MARBLE (ACL 2025). Embodied multi-agent task in Minecraft; tests planning + dynamic-environment coordination. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: AgentBench Overall (OA)
benchmarks.description: AgentBench Overall (OA) composite from THUDM AgentBench (ICLR 2024, arxiv 2308.03688). Aggregate of 8 agent environments: OS, DB, KG, DCG, LTP, HH, WS, M2W. Scale 0-5 (higher is better). First multi-environment LLM-as-Agent benchmark.

benchmarks.name: MetaGPT SoftwareDev Executability
benchmarks.description: Executability score on the SoftwareDev dataset from MetaGPT (ICLR 2024, arxiv 2308.00352). 1-4 scale rating compileability/runnability of multi-agent-framework-generated software (1=fail, 4=flawless). Scaffold + backbone joint score.
